items.title: Register milestone-closeout.json as an artifact fact in process-fact-registry.ts
items.context: Add a PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACT_BY_COMMAND ref (name/path milestone-closeout.json, signed:false, producerCommand story_advance DONE-time capture implemented in handlers/milestone-status.ts, written via store.writeMilestoneCloseout at store.ts ~706) plus a PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY fact entry named artifact:milestone-closeout.json modeled on the adjacent artifact:milestone-ledger.json entry, with producer handlers/milestone-status and a consumer description naming the DONE-phase milestone_status / milestone_closeout frozen-snapshot read path (snapshot-only; never re-blocks DONE).

happy.desc: With the new artifact:milestone-closeout.json registry entry present, npm run test:process-fact-contract passes

edge.desc: The registry entry is unsigned artifact kind with a consumerGate and no signed-artifact semantic, satisfying the contract loop kind/signed/consumerGate assertions

adversarial.desc: Bite test: temporarily removing the milestone-closeout registry entry makes npm run test:process-fact-contract fail with artifact-missing assertion, then restore and re-run green (non-vacuous)

items.title: Add milestone-closeout.json to requiredArtifactFacts in verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
items.context: Insert { name: 'artifact:milestone-closeout.json', path: 'milestone-closeout.json', signed: false } into requiredArtifactFacts (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs ~line 171, next to the milestone-ledger.json line ~196), matching the neighboring assertion pattern. npm run test:process-fact-contract must pass with the registry entry present and fail if the CHK-001 registry entry is removed (non-vacuous check).
